commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED=f8d654a8809802805c4fce869fee4ea3b554adb327f9e710b7d1dcbc47ea7f1a
ORIG='/Users/michal/Downloads/portrait_plotter_150x150mm.svg'
TMP='/tmp/portrait_plotter_150x150mm.svg'
rm -f "$TMP"
/usr/bin/osascript <<'APPLESCRIPT'
tell application "Finder"
  set srcFile to POSIX file "/Users/michal/Downloads/portrait_plotter_150x150mm.svg" as alias
  set destFolder to POSIX file "/tmp" as alias
  duplicate srcFile to destFolder with replacing
end tell
APPLESCRIPT
test -f "$TMP"
ACTUAL=$(shasum -a 256 "$TMP" | awk '{print $1}')
test "$ACTUAL" = "$EXPECTED"
git fetch origin plot-inbox
git reset --hard origin/plot-inbox
DEST=projects/kobra2-neo/inbox/current.svg
cp "$TMP" "$DEST"
VERIFY=$(shasum -a 256 "$DEST" | awk '{print $1}')
test "$VERIFY" = "$EXPECTED"
git add "$DEST"
git commit -m 'Stage exact 150mm portrait SVG for plotting'
git push origin HEAD:plot-inbox
echo RESULT:ARTWORK_PINNED source_sha256=$VERIFY commit=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
